resources.string: Start the server and its streams
Turn on Wireless debugging (or adb tcpip) and use the connection port it shows now, not the pairing port.
Check the address, and that both devices are awake and on the same network.
Pair this phone first: on the device, open Wireless debugging and choose Pair device with pairing code.
Unlock the device and accept the Allow debugging prompt for this phone.
Make sure this is the device\'s ADB connection port, then reconnect.
Check that the device has free storage, then reconnect.
Unlock the device and keep its screen on, then reconnect.
Change the setting the device rejected, shown in the details, then reconnect.
Go back to your devices and connect again: that uses the saved settings, without this session\'s choices.
Choose a different video codec or encoder for this device.
Keep both devices awake and on the same network, then reconnect.
Reconnect once the connection is stable.
